rounds.name: 2004 Italian motorcycle Grand Prix
rounds.notes: Scheduled for 23 laps, the race was stopped after 17 laps because of rain and restarted for the remaining 6 laps, with the grid set by the running order before the stoppage. The 6-lap re-run set the result, and the Results are those of that second part.
